title: Increasing Enrolment for Graduate and Post-graduate Programmes
what_it_is: Increasing Enrolment for Graduate and Post-graduate Programmes

sections.label: University cohort participation and modular courses
sections.summary: By 2020, 40% of each cohort is expected to reach AUs, mainly through applied degree places, while AUs expand shorter skills-based modular courses.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: By 2020, we expect 40% of each cohort will make it to AUs, compared to 34% now.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: This increase will come largely through places in the applied degree programmes at the Singapore Institute of Technology and the Singapore Institute of Management University.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: If the cohort participation rate far exceeds what the economy needs, there can be widespread graduate unemployment, which many economies are experiencing.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Mr Henry Kwek also asked about graduate and post graduate programmes that will see increased enrolment.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: However, the nature of skills deepening is that it may not necessarily involve getting higher qualifications, from Bachelor to Masters to Doctors of Philosophy (PhDs).

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Often, it is about gaining more in-depth skills in a particular area, or learning an adjacent set of skills, through short modular courses.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: That is why the AUs are expanding their offerings of shorter, industry-relevant skills-based modular courses that are accessible to working adults.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Since 2015, the publicly-funded universities have launched more than 200 skills-based modular courses in diverse areas, such as advanced manufacturing, power and clean energy, and programming.
